h1: Burlington bathroom installation in Virginia Water

hero.intro: Properties around Virginia Water tend to sit on generous plots with long driveways, close to the Wentworth Estate and its golf courses, and range from substantial period houses to more recent executive-style builds — which is exactly the spread of housing where Burlington's close-coupled and high-level WCs, pedestal and wall-hung basins, roll-top baths and period-style brassware get specified most. The plot size here usually gives us far more flexibility on layout than a terraced property allows: repositioning a shower to improve natural light, or relocating a waste run for a freestanding bath, rarely runs into a structural wall it can't move around. We fit Burlington ranges across Virginia Water on a fit-only basis, from £3,500.

sections.heading: Burlington across Virginia Water's period and newer houses
sections.body: In the older period houses around Virginia Water, Burlington's classic forms tend to match proportions the house already has — generous bathroom footprints and the ceiling height a high-level WC's exposed flush pipe needs. In the newer executive-style builds nearer Wentworth, the same range is often chosen deliberately to introduce a traditional character. Either way, the fixing underneath is a modern standard: a hidden bracket behind a wall-hung basin, a bearing under a roll-top bath's feet, a precise pedestal alignment behind a classic basin.

sections.heading: What the layout flexibility here means for a Burlington fit
sections.body: Repositioning a shower to pick up better natural light, or moving a waste run to let a freestanding roll-top bath sit correctly in the room rather than wherever the existing pipework happens to run, is something the plot sizes around Virginia Water generally allow for. That matters for Burlington's range specifically — a roll-top bath needs clearance around it to read as freestanding, and a pedestal basin with period brassware needs proportions to match, which is easier to achieve when the layout isn't fixed by a party wall or a small footprint.

sections.heading: Fixing detail and the fit-only model
sections.body: Getting a Burlington installation right depends on confirming the fixing route before anything is ordered — the concealed cistern bracket behind a high-level WC, the support behind a wall-hung basin, the bearing under a roll-top bath. We go through that detail at a £125 survey, and we fit only: you source your Burlington range through a showroom or retailer, and we handle the strip-out, plumbing, tiling and installation from £3,500.

sections.heading: Repairs and aftercare
sections.body: A Burlington installation can need attention later for the same reasons any bathroom does — a close-coupled WC's cistern mechanism, a pedestal shifting slightly, a wall-hung basin's bracket working loose. We repair Burlington fittings across Virginia Water from £200, with emergency call-outs from a £500 minimum. We don't take on standalone regrouting-only visits, but a genuine plumbing or fixing fault is within scope, whether we fitted the piece originally or not.

faqs.q: Does Burlington's range suit a period house around Virginia Water?
faqs.a: Yes — its pedestal and wall-hung basins, close-coupled and high-level WCs and roll-top baths were designed around classic proportions many of the period houses here already have.

faqs.q: Can you reposition a shower or bath to make better use of natural light?
faqs.a: Often, yes. The generous plot sizes around Virginia Water usually give us more flexibility on layout than a terraced property would allow.

faqs.q: Do you supply Burlington sanitaryware, or just install it?
faqs.a: We fit only. You buy your Burlington range through a showroom or retailer, and we handle the installation from £3,500, following a £125 survey.

faqs.q: What makes the fixing detail on a Burlington bath or basin different from a contemporary one?
faqs.a: The silhouette is classic, but the fixing underneath — the bracket, bearing or pedestal alignment — follows a modern standard, and getting it right is what makes the period look hold up once the room is finished.

faqs.q: Do you repair Burlington fittings you didn't originally install?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Repairs start from £200, with a £500 minimum for an emergency call-out, though we don't take on standalone regrouting-only visits.
